links.outcome: Accuracy of triage disposition and red-flag symptom identification in simulated postoperative presentations
links.effect: Appropriate dispositions suggested in only 56% of cases; ChatGPT overestimated urgency in 44%; red-flag symptoms identified with 73% accuracy.
links.quote: However, appropriate patient dispositions were suggested in only 56% of cases.

links.outcome: Recognition of red-flag symptoms and appropriate disposition in simulated complications of varying acuity
links.effect: Red-flag symptoms identified with 73% accuracy; appropriate disposition in 56% of cases, with urgency overestimated in 44%.
links.quote: ChatGPT overestimated the urgency of indicated patient dispositions in 44% of cases, concerning for potential unnecessary increase in healthcare resource utilization.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's diagnostic, triage, and red-flag identification accuracy across 16 simulated patient vignettes of postoperative facelift/necklift complications without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
